I can't confirm the patch. The team note says desktop patch 1.2, but my searches found no source that gives a version for the Tiki Totem, so that claim is unverified. The Terraria Wiki's Tiki page describes the item and the desktop version history doesn't mention it, so the patch would have to be checked in the Tiki Totem's own wiki page or the full patch notes.

CONFIDENCE: 20
